items.title: Planefence and Plane-Alert
items.summary: Which aircraft flew over Arkansas, with photos, airlines and routes, plus a list of interesting aircraft (military, government, rare). Notifications to Discord and others are set up by an administrator.

items.title: Off-site backups
items.summary: Encrypted copies of everything (database, settings, statistics, traffic history) sent to a server, bucket or NAS elsewhere, a small daily copy and a big weekly copy.

items.title: Restore part of a backup
items.summary: Bring back one area (accounts, stations, flight history...) or a single person, station or alert rule instead of everything.

items.title: Aircraft type filter
items.summary: Show only helicopters, jets, turboprops, piston props, large and heavy aircraft, gliders, drones or ground vehicles.

items.title: Collapsible filter sections
items.summary: Every group of map filters folds up like the aircraft details, remembers how you left it, and shows how many filters are active.

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts popup
items.summary: The shortcuts help opens in the middle of the screen, on top of everything.

items.title: Sign-up checklist
items.summary: Registration and password forms list the requirements and tick them as you type, including whether the two passwords match.

items.title: Live Release Notes and Roadmap
items.summary: These two pages update themselves from the project's repository, so they stay current while work is under way.

items.title: Map revamp: one map for every kind of data
items.summary: Preset views (Aircraft, Weather, Radio, Mesh, Everything), one search box for everything, active-filter chips and per-layer filter sections.

items.title: Places, roads, counties and hospitals
items.summary: County and city boundaries, major roads, ZIP codes and hospitals with their trauma level and services, tied to their heliports, searchable by city or ZIP, with a drill-down panel showing everything nearby.

items.title: Weather stations
items.summary: Members' own weather stations (Ecowitt, Tempest, Weather Underground and more) with their own pages, current conditions, rain, wind, lightning and history, and a weather layer on the map, in the style of Weather Underground.

items.title: Radiosondes
items.summary: Weather balloons launched near Arkansas: live tracks, predicted landing places and which of our stations heard them, using the public SondeHub data.

items.title: Repeater directory
items.summary: An Arkansas directory of ham FM and DMR repeaters laid out like the airports, built from entries by local hams and sysops, with links out to RepeaterBook and RadioID.

items.title: Meshtastic and MeshCore nodes
items.summary: Where the mesh nodes are, how far they reach, and what keeps the network healthy, with a guide for joining the Arkansas mesh.

items.title: ACARS messages
items.summary: Aircraft datalink messages received by member stations, shown on the aircraft details and on a live messages page.

items.title: Satellite-relayed aircraft
items.summary: Positions of aircraft reported over Inmarsat, Iridium and HF radio by members with the right receivers.

items.title: Support the project
items.summary: A page for donations toward running costs (Ko-fi and PayPal) and an equipment fund for antennas, receivers and mesh nodes the project installs at host sites. The page appears once the project's donation links are set up.

items.title: Native replay and heatmap
items.summary: Replay a past day and see where traffic flies, built into the map instead of the embedded classic tools.

items.title: More of the classic map's features
items.summary: Multi-select, persistence mode, QNH-corrected altitude and the remaining options of the classic tar1090 map.

items.title: Phone polish
items.summary: A second pass on phones, driven by real-world feedback.

items.title: Email
items.summary: Account verification, password reset by email and alert emails, once a sending service is chosen.

items.title: Admin area allow-list
items.summary: Limit the Admin area to chosen addresses.

items.title: API keys
items.summary: Request a key for a documented public API with fair limits.

items.title: Built to scale and survive a failure
items.summary: Designed so the hub, the MLAT server and the portal can run on more than one machine and share the load.

items.title: Weather alerts on the map
items.summary: National Weather Service warnings (tornado, severe storm, flood) drawn as areas, with alerts to subscribers.

items.title: Earthquakes and river gauges
items.summary: USGS earthquake activity (New Madrid zone) and river and lake levels across Arkansas.

items.title: River traffic (AIS)
items.summary: Barges and boats on the Arkansas, White and Mississippi rivers from member AIS receivers.

items.title: Amateur radio extras
items.summary: APRS stations, space weather and HF propagation, net schedules and Winlink gateways.

items.title: Drone Remote ID
items.summary: Drones that broadcast their identity and position, from member receivers.

items.title: Satellite imagery and passes
items.summary: GOES satellite and lightning layers, and pass predictions for satellites over each station.

items.title: Discord bot, phone app and kiosk mode
items.summary: Alerts in Discord, an installable phone app, and a wall-display mode for clubs and emergency operations centers.

items.title: Station achievements and leaderboards
items.summary: Friendly recognition for range, uptime and contribution.

items.title: One-click updates for the whole stack
items.summary: New services appear on the hub with the Update button and no commands: the stack updater, MLAT and the hub itself.

items.title: MLAT
items.summary: A network MLAT server, MLAT status for every station, an MLAT network page showing who is synchronised with whom, and recognition by MLAT user name.

items.title: How an aircraft is tracked
items.summary: The aircraft card says whether a position came from ADS-B, MLAT, UAT/ADS-R, TIS-B or none, and how many stations hear it.

items.title: Service Status pages
items.summary: A plain-words status page for everyone and an in-depth one for administrators.

items.title: A complete How to Feed guide
items.summary: How ADS-B, MLAT and UAT work, setup for new and existing stations, ports, troubleshooting and privacy.

items.title: Classic map features: units, shortcuts, search, filters
items.summary: Units (aeronautical, metric, imperial), keyboard shortcuts, search with lists and wildcards, data source and flags filters, jump to a place, shareable links, altitude chart and KML export.

items.title: Release Notes
items.summary: What was added, improved and fixed in every release, back to the first.
